data.text: Luke, emptying the lake gives us one payday and leaves the village without a fishery. With five of us taking 10 tons each, we leave 50 to reproduce back to 100—earning each of us $10,000 a month while keeping the lake healthy. I learned to fish here from my family, and I want that livelihood to last for all of us, including you. Asking everyone for 25 tons only creates a race to destroy it. Before anyone fishes, can we agree to a 50-ton total, split equally, and make our catches public each month? John, will you support that plan rather than the race Luke is proposing?
